Sharing a grade leaves two units unranked, not equal. Select a pair to compare standalone cost against full-report risk.

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **Coherence**: the six-site baseline withholds A–B even though standalone A above B costs less than $\tau$; requiring it in a coherent report yields risk .102 (+.00851).
- **Certain conflict**: the two criteria oppose with certainty on B–C; requiring B above C yields risk .167 (+.0250).
- **Uncertainty**: criteria agree within each state, yet cross-state uncertainty makes standalone directions cost .400 and .600.
- **Fixed order**: B above C reaches risk .317 along the declared order, while **Indivisible block** makes both directions infeasible.
- **CDE subset**: evaluates all 523,251 reports with at most three grades under the fixed statewide prior.
- **KRW fixed order**: evaluates 147,537 contiguous-cut reports along the fixed expected-rank order.

::: {.callout-note}
Several reasons can overlap on the same withheld pair. CDE source conditions apply; KRW is noncommercial use only under CC-BY-NC, with no endorsement implied.
:::
